integratedBehavior: Project creation publishes the canonical strict SQLite database; the typed unit-of-work adapter commits aggregate identity, immutable revision, subtype fact, provenance and outbox event atomically. A relocated project reopens under a new lifecycle service and a newly composed factory returns the identical detached revision.

Ordinary database consumers receive opaque connection/cursor capabilities, cannot reach raw sqlite3 handles, replace the authorizer, mutate schema identity/security PRAGMAs, or remove governed triggers. Dedicated initialization and migration authorities stay separate.

Forward migration validates the exact prior profile, creates and verifies a restorable backup and manifest, preserves their canonical path and bytes through persistent Windows authority, runs nine material-step rollback failpoints, and allows healthy future migration attempts and SQLite checkpoint/reopen.

Repository ports contain no SQLite or SQLAlchemy dependency. Adapter failures cross the boundary as bounded context-free repository errors; conflict, not-found, busy-writer retry, late failure rollback, and changed-command idempotency conflicts are deterministic.

The current frozen Core package is authenticated by exact evidence/report/manifest/entrypoint identity before every performance lifecycle. Proposal mode can retain new-package samples but is structurally nonqualifying; only exact reviewed baseline bytes enable the normal gate.

The two implemented critical repository reads use governed unique indexes: latest aggregate revision uses sqlite_autoindex_aggregate_revisions_2 and idempotency replay uses sqlite_autoindex_outbox_events_2. No list/search repository port exists in this slice, so no unimplemented list/search workload is represented as measured.

downstreamHandoff.contract: Consumers import only research_observatory_core.ports.repositories. The local composition root supplies a UnitOfWorkFactory; aggregate revisions, atomic provenance/outbox events, bounded errors, exact replay and optimistic preconditions are stable without exposing a path, SQL statement, connection, cursor or SQLite-specific type.
downstreamHandoff.notes: CAP-02.S03 may add content-addressed objects against the existing documents/object-record contract. Future domain list/search ports must add their own representative workload, EXPLAIN plan and budget rather than extrapolate from the two current indexed point lookups.

residualLimitations: The e2e-local profile has no activated tests/e2e system command yet; its foundation union passed, while this slice's real project-create, relocation, restart and repository handoff is exercised in the affected data integration suite.

The eight new TypeScript compiler exceptions expire 2026-08-31 and authorize only the pinned development-only, governed-input, non-shipped boundary. Upgrade at the first patched stable package and remove them.
Encrypted content-addressed object storage, key-version metadata, quotas and cache eviction are CAP-02.S03; local secrets/privacy controls are CAP-02.S04.

The complete cross-Wave full qualification matrix remains required once at W1 exit; this slice review used the affected profile union and focused incremental replay in accordance with the repository test policy.
